_role: CANONICAL. The one authoritative commercial contract for SENTINEL APEX Intel.
_authority: Synced from the ecosystem canonical contract published by SENTINEL APEX Labs at https://labs.cyberdudebivash.in/commercial-contract.json (source of truth: CYBERDUDEBIVASH-SENTINEL-APEX src/lib/commercial-contract.ts).
_rule: Every buyer-facing price, quota, entitlement and support statement on this platform MUST agree with this file. Do NOT add a competing plan definition. scripts/verify_commercial_contract.py fails the build on drift.
_sync: This is a validated build-time cache, deliberately NOT a runtime fetch: Intel's pricing pages must not go down or go stale-silently because Labs is unreachable. Re-sync by running scripts/verify_commercial_contract.py --sync against the published Labs contract, then commit the diff.
_owner_decision: Owner decision 2026-09-19 (P0 first-revenue go-live): MSSP monthly is $999/month and ENTERPRISE annual is $4,990/year. This decision exists to remove the production ambiguity in which two official surfaces quoted different MSSP prices.
_inr_rate_basis: Implied by the live ENTERPRISE monthly charge the gateway already makes: INR 41,600 / $499 = 83.3667 INR per USD. USD figures are the contract; INR figures are what Razorpay charges. The two must stay consistent at this rate (rounded to whole hundreds of rupees, matching the existing PRO/ENTERPRISE rows).

free.label: FREE
free.support: Community forum. Best-effort uptime, no response target, no outage credit.
free.trial_policy: No free trial. Free evaluation labs run without payment.

pro.label: PRO / SOC
pro.trial_policy: No free trial. Free evaluation labs run without payment.
pro.cancellation_policy: Cancel any time; access runs to the end of the paid period. No pro-rata refund.

enterprise.label: ENTERPRISE SOC
enterprise.trial_policy: No free trial. Free evaluation labs run without payment.
enterprise.cancellation_policy: Cancel any time; access runs to the end of the paid period. No pro-rata refund.

mssp.label: MSSP / SOVEREIGN
mssp.trial_policy: No free trial. Free evaluation labs run without payment.
mssp.cancellation_policy: Cancel any time; access runs to the end of the paid period. No pro-rata refund.

_quota_authority: requests_per_minute is enforced per IP over a 60s window by RATE_LIMITS in workers/intel-gateway/src/index.js. requests_per_day is enforced per API key over a UTC day by DAILY_QUOTAS in workers/intel-gateway/src/daily-quota.js. Both deny with HTTP 429 at the cap, so NO tier may be published as 'unlimited'.
_sla_authority: Uptime, latency, freshness, incident-response and P0 outage-credit terms are the tier-by-tier commitments published in sla.html, measured as a rolling 30-day percentage of successful API health checks from three independent monitoring locations, with planned maintenance (72h notice) excluded and credits claimable within 30 days. These are real contractual commitments backed by a credit mechanism, NOT marketing garnish, and must not be removed. Note this differs deliberately from the Labs storefront contract, which publishes no uptime SLA for its own tool/API surface -- the two are different products.
